changelog: Phase L103.5b — Tier 2 (Заказ+) feature gates wired at 4 callsites. cart.php → CART_BASIC paywall. reservation.php → ORDER_RESERVATION paywall. account.php + customer_orders.php → CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT/CUSTOMER_ORDERS_HIST paywall ONLY when role=customer (staff always see their own kabinet at any tier). Skipped signup.php (SaaS signup, not a tenant feature), auth.php (login must stay open so owners can upgrade), and menu-content* templates (cart button stays — paywall triggers on /cart.php). In legacy single-DB mode all gates are no-ops via Database::hasFeature fail-open. Renders /partials/tier_paywall.php with 402 status.
